text:
sam: quick heads-up — PR #1450 is blocked on a couple of style nits from pre-commit, holding off merge until fixed. I can squash+force-push if folks prefer a single commit.

sam: CI error is from `black`/`ruff` step, output below:```
would reformat src/runtime/cache.py
src/runtime/cache.py:15:1: F401 'typing.List' imported but unused
```

sam: small rename suggestion from review: `get_kv_state` -> `kv_state_for_request` — easy to change but will require a small test update.

maria: thanks for the ping. can you push a fix that only touches formatting + the rename? would rather keep tests separate. :+1:

alex: I can approve after CI passes. if you squash, add a conventional commit-ish message like `fix(runtime): rename get_kv_state -> kv_state_for_request, apply formatting`.

sam: will do a single fixup commit and run `pre-commit run --all-files` locally, then force-push. planning to do in ~20min before the 11:00 PT merge window.

raj: FYI the merge queue will auto-block on the lint step — if flakey, we can temporarily add a skip in the job but prefer not to. if you need a manual merge, ping me.

ci-bot: build #5621 for PR 1450 failed on `format-check` (ruff/black). details: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/5621

sam: pushed `fix(runtime): apply formatting & rename kv helper` (force-pushed). running `pre-commit` now locally, looks clean.

maria: re-running CI now. If green, I’ll approve.

alex: looked at the diff quickly — small nit: please keep the docstring in `kv_state_for_request` one-liner (we split it into two lines in the PR, prefer single line). other than that :thumbsup:

sam: fixed docstring, force-pushed again. thanks for the review.

ci-bot: build #5623 for PR 1450 succeeded. all checks green.

maria: approved.

alex: approved.

sam: thanks all — merging during the 11:00 PT window. will follow up if anything pops. :rocket:
